product.summary: Nova Wallet non-custodial mobile application for Polkadot, Kusama and supported Web3 networks on iOS and Android.
product.notes: Current first-party documentation explicitly establishes iOS/Android distribution and local private-key storage. Initial public launch date remains unresolved.

events.title: Nova Wallet Android v10.8.0 released
events.description: Novasama published Nova Wallet Android v10.8.0 with scam-warning protections, watch-only EVM account support, additional swap routes, and bug fixes, documenting ongoing wallet maintenance in 2026.

events.title: Nova Wallet launched Polkadot debit card integration
events.description: Nova Wallet announced on 2025-06-04 that its partnership with Mercuryo and Mastercard had released a Polkadot-powered debit card that could be topped up with DOT directly from Nova Wallet, adding a new spending capability to the mobile wallet lifecycle.

evidence.title: Nova Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party Nova site identifies Nova Wallet as a non-custodial mobile wallet and provides App Store and Google Play download paths.

evidence.title: 10.8.0 — Nova Wallet — In-app warnings to protect users from scams
evidence.notes: Official Nova Wallet Android release published 2026-02-24.

evidence.title: Nova Wallet x Mercuryo: The First Polkadot Debit Card is Here!
evidence.notes: First-party Nova Wallet announcement states the card had been released and could be topped up with DOT directly from Nova Wallet.
